INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — TERMLY EXAM #17
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Reading 2.2.1 Reading Fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Reading 2.2.1 Reading Fluency.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 2.2.1 Reading Fluency.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Reading 2.2.1 Reading Fluency.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 2.2.1 Reading Fluency.

2. When practising Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting.

   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting.

   D. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Information: Active and passive voice.

6. When practising Reading 1.2.1 Reading for Information: Note Making, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Reading 1.2.1 Reading for Information: Note Making.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Reading 1.2.1 Reading for Information: Note Making.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 1.2.1 Reading for Information: Note Making.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 1.2.1 Reading for Information: Note Making.

7. In INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   B. Only memorise without using the language
   C. Avoid speaking to classmates
   D. Mix random languages with no purpose

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
12. In three clear sentences, explain Reading 7.2.1 Reading Comprehension and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Writing 7.3.1 Creative Writing: Narrative composition and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Listening and Speaking 8.1.1 Expressing Personal Opinions: Direct Object and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Listening and Speaking 9.1.1 Listening for Information: Instructions and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
